title: held() raises when a git call it reads fails
goal: ql_deliver.Pusher.held() raises OSError (so apply --push holds the push) when git for-each-ref, merge-base (an exit other than 0 or 1 for --is-ancestor, or no base) or diff --name-only fails, as it does for an unreadable file; test held_raises_on_git_failure fails each call in turn and asserts the push is held; kb/_self/querylog.md says so
